name: Camp Laurel
description_short: Co-ed overnight camp on Echo Lake in Readfield, Maine, with one seven-week season (June 26 to August 11, 2027). Boys and girls live in separate campuses and choose from athletics, tennis, waterfront sports, adventure, arts and optional riding.

sources.note: 2027 dates and tuition; summer mailing address PO Box 327, Readfield, ME 04355
Program groups run from completed grade 1st-2nd to completed 10th, recorded as rising grades 2 to 11

source.title: Maine Summer Camp Dates & Rates | Summer Schedule for Camp Laurel

warnings: Tuition ($18,500) excludes extra charges: Trip Day/Personal Expenses $600; optional Equestrian $1,500 (3 days/wk) or $2,500 (5 days/wk); 7th Grade Extended Trip $700; 8th & 9th Grade Extended Trip $975; Transportation varies by location.
Two phone numbers: summer 207-685-4945 (Readfield, ME) and winter 203-227-8866 (PO Box 508, Westport, CT 06881). The winter number is recorded since it is currently off-season.
Address is a PO Box, not a street address.

swim_waterfront_notes: Camp fronts on spring-fed Echo Lake. Swimming uses American Red Cross instruction, and the waterfront offers waterskiing, wakeboarding, sailing, paddleboarding, canoeing, kayaking, snorkeling and a swim team.
